content: Riya Singh is a Software Developer with hands-on experience in full-stack web development using Next.js, React.js, TypeScript, Express.js, Supabase, Redis Cache, RESTful APIs, and Server Actions. She can build a full module or feature end-to-end, from backend to frontend. She has experience with scalable frontend and backend workflows, automated testing with Playwright, AI-powered chatbot integration, and AI-assisted development.
Riya is based in Etawah, Uttar Pradesh, India (hometown).
Riya's contact details: email riyasingh454247@gmail.com. She also has LinkedIn, GitHub, and portfolio links available.

Riya has graduated with a B.Tech degree in Computer Science and Engineering from the Institute of Engineering and Technology, Lucknow. She completed her degree in June 2026, having started in November 2022, with a final CGPA of 8.76/10, Division I with Distinction. She is no longer a student — she has fully completed her studies and is now working as a Software Developer.
Riya's technical skills include programming languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, C, SQL, HTML5, CSS3, and Assembly Language.
For frontend development, Riya works with React.js, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, GSAP, and responsive web design.
For backend and databases, Riya works with Express.js, RESTful APIs, Server Actions, Supabase, Redis Cache, MySQL, and JDBC.
For testing, Riya has experience with Playwright, API testing, end-to-end testing, regression testing, and accessibility testing.
Riya's tools and platforms include Git, GitHub, VS Code, MySQL Workbench, Linux, Docker, Nginx, and AI-assisted development tools.
Riya's core computer science foundations include Data Structures & Algorithms, Object-Oriented Programming, Software Engineering, Computer Networks, and Problem Solving.

Riya worked as a Support Developer Intern at Ahurasense Technology Pvt. Ltd. from February 2026 to May 2026 — this internship took place during the final months of her B.Tech degree, before she graduated in June 2026, not after. She worked on full-stack development using Next.js, React.js, TypeScript, Express.js, Supabase, Redis Cache, RESTful APIs, Server Actions, and Linux workflows.
During her internship at Ahurasense Technology, Riya contributed to an e-commerce platform by implementing dashboard modules for Coupons, Saved Addresses, Wishlist, and Help & Support features.
During her internship, Riya built an uploader for videos and images as part of the platform's functionality.
During her internship, Riya used Docker and Linux as part of an assignment, gaining basic working knowledge of containerization with Docker and Linux system workflows.
During her internship, Riya used Nginx to deploy the website through Linux.

During her internship, Riya built reusable UI components, server-side operations, database-driven flows, and scalable frontend-backend application structures. She also performed automated testing with Playwright across API behavior, frontend workflows, accessibility checks, and regression validation.
During her internship, Riya applied Redis caching, integrated a GPT-5.4 food-domain chatbot, and used AI-assisted development to improve debugging speed and feature iteration.
During her internship, Riya used AI tools including Claude, Claude Code, Codex, and ChatGPT to assist with development, debugging, and feature iteration.

Riya built a Personal AI Chatbot — a chatbot that answers questions about her, grounded only in information she has provided. It's a completed personal project exploring Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with a fully free, TypeScript-based stack. Tech stack: Next.js (TypeScript, App Router), Tailwind CSS, Transformers.js for local embeddings, Supabase with pgvector for vector search and storage, Supabase Auth for authentication, and the Groq API for LLM inference, hosted on Vercel.

Riya developed the Online Grocery Website (Feb 2025) — a responsive e-commerce grocery website with product browsing, smooth navigation, and mobile-first layouts, with a reusable frontend structure for a consistent cross-device shopping experience. Tech stack: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript.

Riya engineered a Student Management System (May 2025) — a Java desktop application supporting CRUD operations for structured student record management, integrated with MySQL via JDBC for reliable database connectivity and data persistence. Tech stack: Java Swing, MySQL, JDBC.

Riya built R49, a React & GSAP based web project (Jan 2026) — an interactive React application with GSAP animations, reusable components, and modern UI transitions, with improved responsiveness and visual engagement using Tailwind CSS and animation-driven design. Tech stack: React.js, Tailwind CSS, GSAP.

Riya developed an Image Search Engine (2025) — an application with real-time API integration, backend routing, and responsive rendering, integrating the Unsplash API for keyword-based image retrieval with dynamic search interactions. Tech stack: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6+, Express.js, REST API.

Riya completed an AI & Data Analytics Virtual Internship (Aug–Sep 2025), where she built an Air Quality Forecasting model using Python, NumPy, scikit-learn, and Matplotlib for data preprocessing, model development, and visualization.
Riya completed the Deloitte Australia Data Analytics Job Simulation (Jul 2025), creating Tableau dashboards and applying Excel-based data classification to extract business insights.
Riya completed the Claude 101 Certification by Anthropic (Jun 2026), covering prompt structuring, AI workflows, Projects, Skills, Artifacts, and AI-assisted development use cases.
Riya has additional certifications: NPTEL C Programming and Assembly Language (Aug–Sep 2023), Udemy HTML, CSS and Bootstrap Course (Aug 2024), and Udemy JavaScript Master Course (Apr 2025).

Achievement: Riya cleared GATE (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering), a highly competitive national-level exam, not once but twice, showing strong persistence and improvement. She cleared GATE 2025 with an All India Rank of 45497 and a GATE Score of 258, then cleared GATE 2026 with a significantly improved All India Rank of 25584 and a GATE Score of 363. This is one of her proudest academic achievements and accomplishments.
Riya is an active problem solver on LeetCode and CodeChef, where she regularly practices and solves programming problems. Her profiles on both platforms are linked from her portfolio.
Riya was a Student Mentor at PARMARTH, the Social Education Club at IET Lucknow, from February 2023 to 2024, where she educated 200+ students from underprivileged communities.

Outside of work, Riya enjoys reading books, writing diary entries, and playing badminton. She likes listening to music, and has a strong interest in exploring new technologies — always eager to learn and experiment with new tools and ideas.
